claims.text: BLIND SPOT (scope claim): these checkers establish internal arithmetic consistency of reported statistics only. They do NOT establish that the underlying data exist, that the analysis was appropriate, or that conclusions follow. statcheck is silent on everything it cannot parse (non-APA formats, tables, model-based/Bayesian results) — no flags is not a clean paper. A GRIM fail proves inconsistency, not its cause (typo, wrong N, exclusions all produce fails). SPRITE reconstructions are candidate datasets, never the real data.
boundary: Scope: adapter spec (lane-1 evidence only, DN-010; Spec 004 §2 adapter interface)

evidence.ref: src/tekmerion/adapters/core.py (scope_claim_id on every run record; emission refused without it) + src/tekmerion/adapters/statconsistency.py module docstring (blind spots stated: consistency only, statcheck silence, GRIM proves inconsistency not cause, SPRITE not implemented)
